description: This Java class 'ModuleUtil' contains utility methods for working with modules in the OpenMRS platform. It provides functionalities such as module startup/shutdown, version comparison, resource management within modules, update checking, context refresh, and package extraction from JAR files.

classes.name: ModuleUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing modules within the OpenMRS platform, including startup, shutdown, resource management, version checks, context refreshes, and package extraction.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes and loads modules based on properties, starting all identified modules and verifying mandatory modules are started.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Stops all started modules and clears module-related static variables and caches.

methods.name: insertModuleFile
methods.description: Adds an InputStream as a file in the module repository, preventing duplicates.

methods.name: isOpenmrsVersionInVersions
methods.description: Checks if current OpenMRS version matches any provided version strings.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions
methods.description: Determines if a version matches specified range, including wildcards and version bounds.

methods.name: checkRequiredVersion
methods.description: Verifies that the current version satisfies a required version range, throws ModuleException if not.

methods.name: compareVersion
methods.description: Compares two version strings with support for qualifiers.

methods.name: compareVersionIgnoringQualifier
methods.description: Compares two version strings ignoring any qualifiers such as '-SNAPSHOT'.

methods.name: isVersionWithQualifier
methods.description: Checks if a version string contains a qualifier segment (e.g., '-SNAPSHOT').

methods.name: getModuleRepository
methods.description: Retrieves the directory where modules are stored, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: file2url
methods.description: Converts a File object to a URL.

methods.name: expandJar
methods.description: Expands contents of a JAR file into a temporary directory.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands a stream to a file within a directory.

methods.name: getURLStream
methods.description: Returns an InputStream for the contents at a given URL, following redirects.

methods.name: openConnectionCheckRedirects
methods.description: Follows HTTP redirects up to 5 times to reach the final URL.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Fetches the contents from a URL as a String.

methods.name: checkForModuleUpdates
methods.description: Checks each loaded module for potential updates based on their update URLs.

methods.name: allowAdmin
methods.description: Determines if admin upload/management features are allowed.

methods.name: refreshApplicationContext
methods.description: Refreshes the Spring application context for modules, reinitializing beans and context-specific modules.

methods.name: getMandatoryModules
methods.description: Lists all modules marked as mandatory based on global properties.

methods.name: getModuleForPath
methods.description: Returns the module responsible for a given resource path.

methods.name: getPathForResource
methods.description: Resolves a resource path within a module to its local path.

methods.name: getPackagesFromFile
methods.description: Extracts package names from a given JAR file by inspecting entries.

methods.name: getResourceFromApi
methods.description: Retrieves a resource stream from a module's API JAR located in the module's lib directory.
